title.value: Graduate Programmes by Research (PhD) - August 2027 intake
title.evidence_quote: Graduate Programmes by Research - How to apply - College of Design and Engineering

institution.name: National University of Singapore (NUS), College of Design and Engineering

qualifications: Bachelor's degree with at least Second Class Upper Honours or equivalent expected for PhD/EngD or NUS scholarships
Non-native English speakers: TOEFL iBT or IELTS (Academic) 7.0 minimum (as stated on the CDE page)
Propose a thesis advisor and research area; apply via the NUS Graduate Admission System
International applicants: portal closes 15 January 2027; Singapore residents may apply until 1 March 2027
description_short: PhD (research) admission at NUS College of Design and Engineering for August 2027. International applicants apply by 15 January 2027 via the NUS graduate portal; scholarships such as the President's Graduate Fellowship and NUS Research Scholarship are requested in the same application.

deadline.evidence_quote: the portal for international students closes on 15 January 2027 to enrol in the August 2027 intake

compensation.value: President's Graduate Fellowship up to S$4,800 monthly; NUS Research Scholarship up to S$3,800 monthly before PQE (S$4,300 after)
compensation.evidence_quote: The President's Graduate Fellowship ... up to S$4,800 monthly ... The NUS Research Scholarship ... up to S$3,800 monthly before PhD Qualifying Examination (PQE), with top-up to S$4,300 monthly after passing PQE
